result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well. Found 2 minor layout issues related to horizontally cut-off content.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third item (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge with truncated text, and the horizontal scroll affordance isn't obvious.
issues.suggestion: Add a partial peek with clear scroll indication or adjust card widths so items align to the viewport, ensuring names aren't awkwardly clipped.

issues.description: The category chip row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appears cut off on the right edge, hinting at more items but without clear indication.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible fade or partial next chip to signal horizontal scrollability.
